evidence.reason: Current company page reports 15,000 UK employees across 400 sites.
Current regional roster identifies Beth Whittaker as CHRO and Gaj Premnath as CIO.
Current professional profile matches regional CHRO and employer; mutual introduction and willingness to buy unconfirmed.
Vendor explicitly confirms UK&I IT help-desk automation deployed on ServiceNow, an adjacent automation spend proxy.

why_now: A regional Workday deployment integrates a large application estate and has already required substantial testing. ServiceNow/Konverso automation and ongoing business integration make a targeted change-assurance discussion plausible. Historic test services are strong relevance evidence but do not establish a new procurement deadline.
